description: Highest-priority rule — fires when the engine sees mate in N. Branches by who delivers mate, from whose POV, ply count, and whether mate was already on the board.

fact_glossary.ply: Number of plies to mate (1, 2, 3, ...) or null when engine has no clean ply count
fact_glossary.pawn_swing: Eval swing rounded to pawns (1-9) — used as a fallback when there's no ply count
fact_glossary.delivered_on_this_move: true when this move IS the checkmate move
fact_glossary.mover_delivers: true when the side that just moved is the side delivering the future mate
fact_glossary.mover_is_user: true if the user just moved
fact_glossary.mate_already_on_board: true when mate was already forced before this move (player failed to defend, not caused the mate)

variants.mate_on_for_user_p1: {played_san}. Mate is on for you next move.
variants.mate_on_for_user_pN: {played_san}. Mate is on for you in {ply}.
variants.mate_on_for_user_pawns: {played_san}. Opponent's position is lost — mate is on the board for you.
variants.user_misses_defense_p1: {played_san} misses the defense against mate next move.
variants.user_misses_defense_pN: {played_san} misses the defense against mate in {ply}.
variants.user_already_lost: {played_san} — the position was already lost before this move.
variants.user_allows_pawns: {played_san} loses the position — opponent now has a winning attack.
variants.user_allows_bare: {played_san} — engine sees the position turning against you.
